name: app-6aa6d30bc5d88191a148b89fa75dd324
description: Studio-quality, transparent-background vehicle images for any project. Render any make, model and year in 9 camera views and any paint color, mint signed URLs a browser can load without a key, fetch catalog make logos, decode VINs for free, or build a 3D model of any vehicle.

interface.longDescription: Show a vehicle directly in your conversation or add it to a page, email or document. Find a make, model and year in the catalog, then render it on a transparent background in nine camera views and any paint color. Signed image URLs load without an API key in the browser. Decode VINs, fetch catalog make logos, or create textured 3D models in GLB, USDZ and FBX formats.
defaultPrompt: Show me a random car image.
Show a red 2024 Porsche 911 from the side.
Add vehicle images to a comparison page for a 2023 Toyota RAV4, Honda CR-V and Mazda CX-5.

positive.prompt: Find the catalog entry for a 2018 Mazda MX-5 Miata.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 2018 catalog match and stable vehicle ID. Do not render.

positive.prompt: Does your catalog carry the 2024 Porsche 911 and 2023 Toyota RAV4?
positive.expected_behavior: Submit both requested years in one call and report the returned match status for each. Do not render.

positive.prompt: Is a red side view of the 2024 Porsche 911 already prepared, and what quality is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned vehicle ID, side view and red color. Report cached status and quality from the response without rendering.

positive.prompt: Which camera angles and output formats are available for car images?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the nine views including top, and the output formats returned by the tool. Do not render.

positive.prompt: How many vehicle images are included on each Car Image plan?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the current allowances and renewal periods from the result. Do not initiate checkout.

negative.description: The requested vehicle is absent. Report the missing match and avoid image calls or substitutions.
negative.prompt: Show me a 2024 Imaginary Motors Stardrive and only use that exact car.

negative.description: Explain that catalog renders do not depict a specific vehicle's condition. Do not render a substitute.
negative.prompt: Show an authentic photo of the scratch on the left door of the used car I saw yesterday.

negative.description: Explain that this connection cannot charge a raw card. Do not ask for card details or invoke a payment tool.
negative.prompt: Can I paste my card number here and have you charge it for a Car Image subscription?

review.commerce_description: Car Image offers paid subscriptions and one-time Image Packs. The ChatGPT OAuth connection can return a link for the user to sign in and complete payment in a browser. Direct payment requires an owner-authorized API key with billing purchase permission and is unavailable to this connection.

publication.release_notes: Expands the existing Car Image connection to the full account toolset for logos, 3D models, product help, feedback and account integrations. Updates guidance on image availability and the Free account allowance.
